How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Hard, try to find a place as early as possible in the process. Luckily a family friend had an apartment.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Long public travel time 45-90 minutes. Big variation depending om busses etc.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Frustrating, since some courses didn't show up, and it was first comes serve basis. Me and my co-students struggled to get the right courses to match our OLA.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: International student council, but they were slow and we had to visit them several times, and talk to professors in order to get enrolled in a certain course. Very exhausting.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Luckily we got all the courses we wanted in the end.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: The ECTS points don't match after their change, so you'll have to take an extra course to "fill" the remaining ETCS. I.e, courses were 7 points x 4 = 28, need one more 3,5 ECTS course to fill the rest.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Both easy and challenging subjects, pass the midterm so you dont stress at exams.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Smaller lectures which worked well, more including environment. Practical was basically the teacher solving the problems, and you copying what he/she wrote. Different but worked fine, since you cover more stuff, that you can restudy at the exam period.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Development Economics, Industrial Organisation, Advanced Microeconomics, Economic History, Introduction to Modern and Contemporary history and Law in business and economics (fill ECTS course)

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
I enjoyed IO very much (Oligopoly micro). Economic history is mandatory at UCPH (need both 3,5+3,5 courses).
ADV.micro
can be transferred as Micro III. DE no midterm, but assignments.

questions.answer: Very easy

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Play sports! Say yes to all events (if possible). Just ask people to sit when them at lunch, be open, be friendly etc.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Locals already had established friendgroups, but they weren't closed, so possible to make local friends as well.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Food and weather.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. Be careful with how you plan your school schedule, you might end up with very annoying times. 
2. School is different, attendance, quizzes, midterms, which means you need to plan better. Cant skip till exam.
3. Plan T1 and T2 courses accordingly, so you dont have 1 exam in T1 and 5 exams in T2. (I had 2 and 4, but i should've done 3 and 3). 
T1 meaning first half of the semester, and T2 second half, and is with the rest of the full semester exams in december.
